description: Datadog monitors for the Tutor Profiles architecture (#2092). All monitors target Prometheus-style metrics exposed by the NestJS backend via OpenMetrics and ingested by the Datadog Agent. The Tutor Profiles module is planned: monitors activate automatically once the backend starts emitting the hellotalk_tutor_profiles_* metrics documented in docs/tutor-profiles-monitoring.md.

monitors.name: [Tutor Profiles] Zero tutor profile creation activity
monitors.message:
{{#is_alert}}
No tutor profiles have been created in the last 30 minutes. This could indicate a complete outage of the tutor onboarding pipeline or zero new tutor signups.

**Actions:**
1. Verify the NestJS backend is running and healthy.
2. Check the tutor profile creation API directly.
3. Confirm the Datadog Agent is scraping the metrics endpoint correctly.
4. Check for deployment or infrastructure incidents.
{{/is_alert}}
